payload.description_as_reported: redundancy, involving the duplication of information via image and text, also develops a strong mental model of the meaning.
payload.pattern: Offer a toggle that hides on-screen text which merely duplicates adjacent visual content once the user has viewed the associated image {view_threshold} times, excluding any text serving an accessibility function such as captions, subtitles, transcripts, alt text or screen-reader labels, and keeping a manual re-enable option visible at all times.

decision_note: Narrowed before approval: the original pattern hid 'redundant text captions', but captions are accessibility infrastructure, not redundancy. That directly violated MM-15's own hard rule accessibility_preserved (severity block) — 'comprehension gains for some users may not remove access for others' — and the pipeline raised no flag. Narrowed to on-screen text that merely duplicates adjacent visual content, with an explicit exclusion for any text serving an accessibility function.
